question: Which of the following Indian Navy personnel received the Shaurya Chakra 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Capt. Sharad Sinsunwal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Capt. Sharad Sinsunwal** received the Shaurya Chakra in 2024 for his exceptional bravery and courage.
 
• The Shaurya Chakra is awarded for valor, courageous action, or self-sacrifice while not engaged in direct action with the enemy.
 
• It is the third highest peacetime gallantry award in India, following the Ashoka Chakra and the Kirti Chakra.
 
• Capt. Sharad Sinsunwal's actions were recognized as instrumental in a critical mission, displaying outstanding leadership and bravery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shaurya Chakra**

 
 
• Established on 4th January 1952, it is awarded to civilians as well as military personnel.
 
• The medal is circular in shape, made of bronze, and depicts a lotus in the center with the words "Shaurya Chakra" inscribed in Hindi and English.
 
• It is awarded for acts of gallantry and self-sacrifice outside the battlefield, such as during counter-terrorism operations.
 
 
 
• **Ashoka Chakra**
 
 
• The highest peacetime gallantry award in India.
 
• It is awarded for the most conspicuous bravery or some daring or pre-eminent valor or self-sacrifice other than in the face of the enemy.
 
 
 
• **Kirti Chakra**
 
 
• The second highest peacetime gallantry award in India.
 
• It is awarded for valor, courageous action, or self-sacrifice away from the battlefield.
 
 
 
• **Gallantry Awards in India**
 
 
• Gallantry awards are given to honor acts of bravery and sacrifice by individuals in the armed forces, other lawfully constituted forces, and civilians.
 
• They are categorized into two types: Gallantry in the face of the enemy and Gallantry other than in the face of the enemy.
